name: Multi-repo, image-embedded (hook-driven)
description: Demonstrates docs/extensions/lifecycle-hooks.md's multi-repo section, hook branch: two toy repos ('alpha', 'beta') already baked into the image (see app/server/example/images/multi-repo-demo/), each independently switchable via its own option, both switched/restarted by a single lifecycle:launch hook - re-runnable at any later point via `dockside hook run <devtainer> lifecycle:launch`, without recreating the container. Build the image first: docker build -t dockside-example-multi-repo:latest app/server/example/images/multi-repo-demo/. Compare to 06-image-embedded-multi-repo-entrypoint.json, which switches the same two repos the same way but once only, at container-create time, via its own command instead of a hook - re-switching there means recreating the devtainer.
